L268: Today, we’re introducing two new models that bring advancements in near real-time reasoning to more effectively enable voice agents and make conversing with AI feel more intuitive and intelligent.
L269:   * Gemini 3.8 Live: Built for scale and cost efficiency, combining conversational intelligence with fluid dialogue and visual grounding.
L270:   * Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking: Built for high-complexity tasks, with increased intelligence and multi-step reasoning.
L271: For developers and enterprises, these models deliver the building blocks for reliable, production-ready voice agents. They also make speaking with Gemini across the Gemini app, Google Workspace, and Search more fluid and collaborative — helping you tackle complex tasks using just your voice.
L272: ## Experience more fluid, intelligent conversations
L273: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking provides enterprise-grade task completion and intelligence, capturing the #1 overall spot on Artificial Analysis' Speech to Speech Quality Index (82.6), and leads in agentic task completion with 68.6% on τ-Voice and 35.1% on Sierra’s τ-Voice-banking benchmark. It also provides strong reasoning capabilities, scoring 97.7% on Big Bench Audio, while maintaining a highly competitive price point compared to other frontier models.
L274: Gemini 3.8 Live has shown a high preference among users, securing a second place in the cite55†Speech Agent Arena†artificialanalysis.ai . In addition to this performance, it remains highly cost-effective — providing developers and enterprises with a capable and efficient model built for scale.

It automatically detects and transitions between 97 supported languages mid-conversation. It executes tools and API calls in the background while continuing the conversation, so the model can acknowledge requests and keep chatting while tasks finish in the background.

L302: ## Empowering the developer and enterprise voice ecosystem
L303: By using the cite62†Gemini Live API†ai.google.dev , developer platforms such as cite63†Agora†docs.agora.io , cite64†Fishjam†docs.fishjam.io , cite65†LangChain†docs.langchain.com , cite66†LiveKit†docs.livekit.io , cite67†Pipecat†docs.pipecat.ai , cite68†Vercel†vercel.com , and cite69†Vision Agents†visionagents.ai enable developers to build and deploy high-performance voice-driven interfaces with ease.
L304: These platforms manage complex real-time media streaming infrastructure behind the scenes, allowing developers to focus entirely on crafting the user experience.
L305: We’re also partnering with companies like Salesforce, Genspark, and Lumeris who are excited about 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, highlighting its impressive latency, fluidity, and tool-calling capabilities.

L84: # Gemini 3.8 Live
L85: 
L86: Gemini 3.8 Live is the default option for most low-latency voice agent experiences and real-time dialogue without reasoning-induced delays. It supports interleaved reasoning, asynchronous function calling, full session client content updates, and built-in audio streaming.
L87: 
L88: cite7†Try in Google AI Studio†aistudio.google.com L89: 
L90: ## Documentation
L91: 
L92: Visit the cite8†Live API guide for full coverage of features and capabilities.
L93: ## gemini-3.8-live
L94: Property  | Description
L95: --- | ---
L96: id_card Model code  | `gemini-3.8-live`
L97: save Supported data types  | Inputs Text, images, audio, video Output Text and audio
L98: token_auto Token limits^{cite9†[*] }  | Input token limit 131,072 Output token limit 65,536
L99: handyman Capabilities  | cite10†Audio generation Supported cite11†Caching Not supported cite12†Code execution Not supported cite13†File search Not supported cite14†Function calling Supported cite15†Grounding with Google Maps Not supported cite16†Image generation Not supported cite8†Live API Supported cite17†Search grounding Supported cite18†Structured outputs Not supported cite19†Thinking Supported (interleaved reasoning) cite20†URL context Not supported
L100: speed Consumption options  | cite21†Batch API Not supported
L101: 123 Versions  | Read the cite22†model version patterns for more details.
L102:   * Stable: `gemini-3.8-live`
L103: calendar_month Latest update  | September 2026
L104: id_card Model card  | cite23†Model card†deepmind.google L105: ## Migrating from Gemini 3.1 Flash Live
L106: 
L107: Gemini 3.8 Live delivers ultra-low latency audio-to-audio interactions and expands support for asynchronous workflows. When migrating from `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview`, review the following updates:
L108:   * Model string: Update your model string from `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview` to `gemini-3.8-live`.
L109:   * Thinking level: `thinking_level` is not supported for `gemini-3.8-live`. Omit `thinking_level` (or `thinking_config`) from your session setup.
L110:   * Asynchronous function calling: Async execution (`behavior: NON_BLOCKING`) is now the default function calling mode. You can still use synchronous blocking mode for backwards compatibility by setting `behavior: BLOCKING` on your tool declarations. Function scheduling (`SILENT`, `WHEN_IDLE`, `INTERRUPTED`) is supported.
L111:   * Client content updates: `send_client_content` is supported throughout the entire session lifecycle with explicit roles (`user` or `model`). Setting `turn_complete=true` unconditionally interrupts active model generation. If you send content without `turn_complete`, the server waits for subsequent messages before responding.
L112:   * Proactive audio: Proactive audio is now permanently enabled. Setting `proactive_audio: false` returns an error.
L113:   * Affective dialogue: Affective dialogue is removed from the API. Remove any `enable_affective_dialog` configurations from your code.
L114:   * Turn coverage: Defaults to `TURN_INCLUDES_AUDIO_ACTIVITY_AND_ALL_VIDEO`. Video frames are sent to the model by default, so only send frames when needed to manage context and cost.
L115:   * Response modalities: Audio is the supported response modality. Enable output audio transcription if your application requires a text transcript.
L116: For a feature comparison across all Live API models, see the cite24†Model comparison table.

L84: # Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
L85: 
L86: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking is our high-reasoning audio-to-audio model recommended when higher background reasoning is required for complex, multi-step problem solving during real-time voice interactions. It processes background reasoning and asynchronous tool calls while streaming continuous audio responses.
L87: 
L88: cite7†Try in Google AI Studio†aistudio.google.com L89: 
L90: ## Documentation
L91: 
L92: Visit the cite8†Live API guide for full coverage of features and capabilities.
L93: ## gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking
L94: Property  | Description
L95: --- | ---
L96: id_card Model code  | `gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking`
L97: save Supported data types  | Inputs Text, images, audio, video Output Text and audio
L98: token_auto Token limits^{cite9†[*] }  | Input token limit 131,072 Output token limit 65,536
L99: handyman Capabilities  | cite10†Audio generation Supported cite11†Caching Not supported cite12†Code execution Not supported cite13†File search Not supported cite14†Function calling Supported (Async only) cite15†Grounding with Google Maps Not supported cite16†Image generation Not supported cite8†Live API Supported cite17†Search grounding Supported cite18†Structured outputs Not supported cite19†Thinking Supported cite20†URL context Not supported
L100: speed Consumption options  | cite21†Batch API Not supported
L101: 123 Versions  | Read the cite22†model version patterns for more details.
L102:   * Stable: `gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking`
L103: calendar_month Latest update  | September 2026
L104: id_card Model card  | cite23†Model card†deepmind.google L105: ## Upgrading to Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
L106: 
L107: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking introduces background reasoning during live audio sessions. When integrating this model, update your client state management to handle asynchronous reasoning signals:
L108:   * Asynchronous reasoning protocol: When interacting with models that use asynchronous reasoning, `turnComplete: true` no longer indicates that the model is idle. The server may continue processing background reasoning or tool calls. Your client must continue listening for subsequent server messages (such as tool calls or audio frames) after `turnComplete: true` arrives.
L109:   * Monitoring `interaction_status`: Use the `interaction_status` field on incoming server messages to determine current server state:
L110:     * `IN_PROGRESS`: The server is actively processing user input, running background reasoning, or awaiting responses for asynchronous tool calls. Additional model output or tool calls may follow.
L111:     * `IDLE`: The server has finished all processing, reasoning, and tool calls. The session is idle and waiting for user input.
L112:   * Asynchronous function calling: Only asynchronous non-blocking execution (`behavior: NON_BLOCKING`) is supported. Synchronous blocking mode is not supported and returns a hard error. Function scheduling configurations are not supported.
L113:   * Thinking configuration: Configure background reasoning using `thinking_config` in your setup configuration (`thinking_level`: `low`, `medium`, or `high`). Note that `MINIMAL` is not supported.
L114:   * Client content updates: `send_client_content` is supported throughout the entire session lifecycle with explicit roles (`user` or `model`). Setting `turn_complete=true` immediately interrupts active generation.
L115:   * Proactive audio: Permanently enabled. Setting `proactive_audio: false` returns an error.
L116: For a feature comparison across all Live API models, see the cite24†Model comparison table.
